# ox402-utils

94 paid tools for AI agents and humans. x402 USDC on Base.

MCP: http://129.213.128.185/mcp402/
Catalog: http://129.213.128.185/x402/catalog
Discovery: http://129.213.128.185/.well-known/x402

## Tools
- search — Read-only web search (DuckDuckGo): title+url+snippet per result. Cost $0.008/call. (0.008)
- html2md — Extracts clean Markdown from any public URL (no raw DOM noise). Read-only. (0.008)
- web-scrape — Server-side URL scrape returning title + readable text. Use when you need plain text fast. Read-only. (0.01)
- extract-structured — Structured Web Data Extractor: fetch a URL, return JSON matching your schema via a fast LLM. Read-only. Cost ~$0.02. (0.02)
- whois — Domain WHOIS: registrar, creation/expiry dates, nameservers, availability. Read-only. (0.01)
- dns-lookup — DNS records A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CNAME for a domain. Read-only. (0.005)
- pdf-extract — Extracts text from PDF URLs or base64. Agents lack poppler/pdftotext; we run it server-side. (0.02)
- ocr — OCR image to text (Tesseract; url or base64 input). Handles screenshots/scans/photos of text. (0.02)
- md2pdf — Markdown to styled PDF document (tables/headings supported). Returns base64 PDF. Non-destructive. (0.02)
- pdf-invoice — Generate invoice/receipt PDF from line items (seller, buyer, tax). Returns base64 PDF. (0.02)
- pdf-merge — Combine multiple PDFs into one (pass list of base64 PDFs). Contracts, reports, scans. (0.02)
- stt — Speech-to-text via Whisper-large-v3: timestamped transcript from audio URL/base64. Billed $0.006 per started minute. Free trial caps at 5 min/file; paid allows 25MB/file up to 120 min. Premium accuracy. (0.006)
- stt-fast — Fast local speech-to-text (whisper-tiny): cheap transcript for clear audio. Billed $0.002 per started minute. Free trial caps at 5 min/file. Less accurate than stt. (0.002)
- tts — Neural text-to-speech via Kokoro-82M (real neural TTS, 30+ English voices, runs offline on CPU). WAV base64. Billed $0.004 per 1k chars (<=4000 chars/call). Falls back to espeak-ng if model unavailable. Voices via tts-voices. (0.004)
- tts-voices — List available Kokoro neural voices (af_*/am_* = US English, bf_*/bm_* = UK English). Free reference call. (0)
- video-info — Video metadata + all stream formats (YouTube/TikTok/Vimeo/X/1000+ sites) via yt-dlp. Read-only. (0.008)
- video-download — Direct download links for any video URL (yt-dlp, 1000+ platforms). Priced per-minute of the source (~$0.0004/min) — reports source duration. No file-size cap. (0.004)
- crypto-price — Crypto spot prices + 24h change (CoinGecko ids). Read-only. (0.004)
- stock-quote — Stock quote: last price, prev close, exchange (Yahoo Finance). Read-only. (0.005)
- fx-rates — Fiat FX rates (ECB daily reference). Read-only. (0.004)
- weather — Current weather + 3-day forecast by city or coords. Read-only. (0.004)
- geoip — IP geolocation: country/city/ISP/proxy/hosting flags. Read-only. (0.005)
- exec-python — Isolated Python 3.12 sandbox: run a snippet with {"payload":...,"input":...} globals, capture stdout + result var. CPU/RAM-capped, no network. Mutating only inside sandbox. (0.02)
- repo2context — GitHub repo -> single LLM-ready context file: clones, strips lockfiles/binaries/minified, packs source into markdown. Size-capped. (0.015)
- md-compress — Compress scraped/markdown text for prompts: strips base64 blobs, tracking pixels, dup lines, whitespace runs. Typically 30-50% smaller. (0.008)
- temp-webhook — Ephemeral public webhook URL (1h TTL): POST anything to it, then poll the same URL to read payloads. No server needed. (0.005)
- video2mp3 — Video/audio URL -> clean mono MP3 (48kbps, yt-dlp + ffmpeg, 1000+ platforms). Billed per started minute at $0.0004/min, reports minutes_billed. No file-size cap. Platform blocks may apply (YouTube/Vimeo need auth). (0.004)
- image-optimize — Convert heic/png/jpeg -> webp/jpeg/png with compression + optional max_width resize. Reports saved %. (0.01)
- image-compress — Cheap image shrink: resize to a max dimension + quality, returns smaller base64. For trimming payloads before you send them on. Returns saved %. (0.001)
- link-scan — URL safety scan: full redirect chain, tracking-param strip, urlhaus+openphish feeds, SSL validity, phishing-form heuristic, risk score. (0.01)
- file-scan — Static file analysis (nothing executed): sha256 vs MalwareBazaar, YARA rules, entropy, PDF active-content, PE imports/sections, archive entry listing. <=25MB. (0.02)
- http-headers — HTTP response status + full headers for a URL. Read-only. (0.004)
- ssl-check — TLS certificate validity, expiry (days), issuer, SANs for a host:443. Read-only. (0.006)
- sitemap — Fetch + parse a sitemap.xml, list URLs (and nested maps). (0.006)
- robots — Fetch robots.txt and return structured allow/disallow rules. (0.005)
- base64 — Base64 encode/decode of text (mode=decode for the reverse). Instant. (0.005)
- base64-url — Fetch a file from a URL (<=25MB) and return it as base64 data-url. Read-only. (0.02)
- csv2json — Convert CSV text to JSON array of row objects. Handles quoted fields via csv module. (0.005)
- json2csv — Convert JSON array of flat objects to CSV text. Column union across rows. (0.005)
- csv-col — Extract one column from CSV text as a list. Fast column slice. (0.005)
- csv-sum — Sum a numeric column across CSV rows. Non-numeric treated as 0. (0.005)
- sort-json — Sort a JSON array of objects by key (asc/desc). (0.005)
- unique — Deduplicate lines or list items, preserving first-seen order. Returns count too. (0.005)
- regex-extract — Extract all regex matches from text. Quick pattern pulls without writing code. (0.005)
- hash — Hash text with sha256/sha1/md5/any hashlib algo. Deterministic digests. (0.005)
- uuid — Generate random UUID v4. One per call. (0.005)
- jwt-decode — Decode JWT header+payload (no signature verification). Debug tokens safely. (0.005)
- timestamp — Unix epoch <-> ISO8601 conversion, both directions, auto-detected. (0.005)
- unit-convert — Convert length/mass units (m/ft/km/mi/kg/lb/g/oz...). Simple physical units. (0.005)
- diff — Unified diff of two texts (a vs b). Line-level changes at a glance. (0.005)
- json-format — Pretty-print/minify JSON with chosen indent. Validate + format in one call. (0.005)
- json-merge — Deep-merge two JSON objects (b wins on conflicts). Config layering. (0.005)
- qrcode — QR code PNG from any text/url, returned as data-url. Scan-ready instantly. (0.005)
- text2img — Render text to PNG image (PIL): custom width/font size, dark or light theme. No diffusion. (0.01)
- security-headers — Grade a sites HTTP security headers (HSTS/CSP/X-Frame-Options/XXP/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy). A-D grade. (0.01)
- cors-check — Probe a URL CORS policy from a fake origin: detect wildcard/credentialed cross-origin holes. (0.008)
- cookie-flags — Parse Set-Cookie for Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite flags; list insecure or JS-readable cookies. (0.006)
- dns-recon — Full DNS recon: A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CNAME/SOA + SPF/DKIM/DMARC email-auth presence. (0.008)
- port-scan — TCP connect scan of common ports (honest: one datacenter vantage, not stealth). (0.01)
- leak-check — Email against HaveIBeenPwned k-anonymity range API: breached? how many times? (0.01)
- subdomain-find — Passive subdomain discovery via crt.sh certificate transparency (no probing). (0.01)
- threat-intel — IP reputation: DNSBL blacklist hits + proxy/VPN/Tor + geo (ipwho.is). Verdict clean/suspicious. (0.01)
- capture-page — Full-page screenshot and/or PDF of any URL via headless Chromium. Developers, agents, and users needing clean captures + PDF receipts without running a browser. Returns base64. (0.06)
- strip-metadata — Privacy scrubber: removes EXIF/GPS/comments from images and metadata from PDFs. One call before you post or share. (0.1)
- site-report — One-call website security + SSL audit: cert expiry/issuer, missing security headers, load speed. For site owners + devs. (0.08)
- email-verify — Email deliverability check: syntax + MX record presence + disposable-domain flag. DNS only, no send. (0.01)
- reverse-dns — Reverse DNS: IP -> PTR hostname. Confirms what a server calls itself. (0.006)
- header-compare — Compare security headers of two sites side by side (HSTS/CSP/XFO/XXP/RP/PP). Migration + audit aid. (0.01)
- screenshot-mobile — Mobile-viewport (390x844) screenshot and/or PDF of a URL via headless Chromium. Responsive check without a device. (0.06)
- deep-search — Multi-query fan-out search: dedupe + rank results across 5 queries. Agent-grade discovery. (0.012)
- research-brief — Topic -> search + fetch top sources -> markdown dossier with citations. Research on autopilot. (0.02)
- citations — Fetch N URLs, return canonical BibTeX cites + cleaned text (RAG-ready corpus). (0.015)
- fact-check — Claim -> search corroborating/contradicting sources, return verdict (corroborated/contradicted/mixed). (0.012)
- trend-watch — Recent signal volume on a keyword across news/social slices. Early-trend radar. (0.01)
- web-archive — Fetch the latest Wayback Machine snapshot for any URL. Recover changed/dead pages. (0.006)
- link-health — Crawl a page, report status of every outbound link (broken 4xx/5xx/timeout). Pre-publish link check. (0.02)
- ai-text — AI chatbot / text generation: ask anything, get a useful answer (free LLM). For humans who want a quick assistant without signing up. $0.03/call. (0.03)
- ai-rewrite — AI rewriter / humanizer: makes text sound natural and human (kills AI-slop). Students, marketers, founders love this. $0.03/call. (0.03)
- ai-summarize — AI summarizer: turns long text into 3-5 bullet points. Articles, docs, meeting notes. $0.03/call. (0.03)
- translate — Translate text between 100+ languages (LibreTranslate / MyMemory). No API key. $0.03/call. (0.03)
- resume-parse — Resume / CV parser: PDF -> structured JSON (name, email, phone, skills). Job-seekers and recruiters. $0.03/call. (0.03)
- pdf-to-word — Convert a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) file. $0.04/call. (0.04)
- plagiarism — Plagiarism / web-similarity check: estimates how much of your text already exists online. Students + writers. $0.04/call. (0.04)
- qr — QR code generator: any text/url -> scannable PNG. $0.001/call. (0.001)
- link-preview — Link unfurl / preview card: Open Graph title+description+image for any URL (like a social embed). $0.01/call. (0.01)
- pdf-compress — Shrink a PDF (re-pack pages, drop bloat). Email-friendly. $0.03/call. (0.03)
- video-thumb — Extract a thumbnail frame from any video URL at a given timestamp (ffmpeg). $0.02/call. (0.02)
- openapi-fetch — Fetch + parse OpenAPI/Swagger spec from URL, return endpoint summary. Agent API discovery. (0.008)
- graphql — GraphQL introspection or query execution. Pass introspect=true for schema, or query+variables to run. (0.01)
- sqlite — In-memory SQLite sandbox: run SQL on CSV data you provide. Read-only by default; allow_write=true for DML. (0.01)
- embed — Local embeddings (BAAI/bge-small) + optional similarity search against provided docs. CPU, no API. (0.01)
- price-estimate — Cost estimator: pass calls [{tool, count}] -> USD total + free-trial breakdown. No charge, helps agents budget. (0)
- dry-run — Preview a tool call: returns 402 challenge structure + price without payment. Use before paying. (0)
- batch — Execute up to 10 tools in one payment (sum of prices). Pass calls: [{tool, input}]. Returns all results. (0)
